tools.description: Show which platforms are configured (their required secrets are present in the environment).
tools.name: adscapi_check

tools.description: Fire a conversion from an AGENT-COMMERCE purchase (ACP / AP2) that has no browser or pixel. Pass the settled ACP checkout session or AP2 payment mandate; adscapi maps it to a canonical event and fans it out to every ad platform so the ad that drove the agent gets credit.

payload.description: The settled ACP CheckoutSession or AP2 PaymentMandate object.

protocol.description: Which agent-commerce protocol the payload is from.

tools.name: adscapi_fire_agent_conversion

tools.description: THE conversion verb: fire one canonical conversion event to every configured ad platform at once (fan-out + dedup). Pass raw identity — adscapi hashes per platform. More match keys → higher match rate → lower CAC.

clickIds.description: Captured click ids, e.g. { fbclid, gclid, ttclid }.

event.description: Canonical event name, e.g. purchase, lead, signup.

eventId.description: Stable id for cross-pixel/CAPI dedup (auto-derived if omitted).

value.description: Conversion value (send predicted LTV for value-based bidding).

tools.name: adscapi_fire_conversion

tools.description: List every ad-platform destination, its support level, and required secrets.
tools.name: adscapi_platforms

tools.description: Read spend / impressions / conversions / ROAS back from an ad platform (Meta, Google Ads, or TikTok) for a date range — closes the loop so an agent can optimize.
tools.name: adscapi_report

tools.description: Deprecated alias of adscapi_fire_conversion. Fire one canonical conversion event to every configured platform.

email.description: Raw email — adscapi hashes it per platform.

event.description: Canonical event name, e.g. purchase, lead, signup.

tools.name: adscapi_track

tools.description: Live-check that configured platform tokens actually work (hits each platform API). Optionally limit to one platform.

platform.description: Limit the check to one platform key, e.g. meta.

tools.name: adscapi_verify
